messages:
Jules: Heads-up — CI is red on image publish 4523, failing at the final manifest step when pushing to registry.redwood: `PUT /v2/redwood/app/manifests/latest` returns 422 with `manifest invalid`.
ci-bot: buildkite: Build #4523 — FAILED — https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/4523 (job: image-publish)
Anika: I just merged PR #2381 (small Dockerfile tweak — added a scratch final stage and a symlink). Could be related. @Ben can you take a look?
Ben: Looking now. The push log shows blobs uploaded OK but manifest validate fails. snippet:
```
> PUT /v2/redwood/app/blobs/uploads/uuid 201
> PATCH /v2/redwood/app/blobs/uploads/uuid?digest=sha256:... 202
> PUT /v2/redwood/app/manifests/latest 422
{"errors":[{"code":"MANIFEST_INVALID","message":"manifest fails schema validation"}]}
```
Priya: Is the builder the usual `buildx` multi-platform flow? Kaniko vs buildx can change manifest schema (v2 list vs single manifest).
Jules: Buildkite step uses `buildx bake` with `--push`. We recently flipped `platforms: linux/amd64` in the bake file in that PR.
Anika: I changed the final stage from `FROM scratch` to `FROM scratch AS final` and then `COPY --from=builder /opt/app /opt/app` — nothing fancy. No explicit `CMD` change.
Ben: Could be subtle: if buildx produces a manifest list (multi-arch) but registry expects a single manifest for this repo policy, it might reject. Also some registries validate config/media types strictly.
OpsBot: registry-monitor: Increased manifest validation errors (422) observed for repository `redwood/app` starting 2024-06-03T14:02Z — correlated with push rate from buildx/agents.
Priya: Can someone try re-running the same build with `DOCKER_CLI_EXPERIMENTAL=disabled` or force single-platform `--platform linux/amd64` to confirm? Also try pushing the same built image to a dev repo to isolate registry policy.
Jules: I'll queue a rerun with `--platform linux/amd64` and also a rerun with `--no-cache` to force rebuild. Will post results.
Ben: Meanwhile, can you paste `docker manifest inspect` or `skopeo inspect` output for the failed manifest digest (if available)? That will show if it's a manifest list vs single manifest.
Jules: paste:
```
skopeo inspect docker://registry.redwood/redwood/app:sha256:abcdef
FATA[0000] Error: manifest invalid: unsupported schemaVersion
```
Anika: That error makes me think builder emitted an unsupported media type for the config. Maybe buildx version bump changed the default `mediaType` for config blobs.
Priya: I'll loop in registry infra: @registry-team — can you check if we've recently enabled stricter manifest schema validation? Any policy changes this morning?
Ben: Short triage plan: 1) Rerun with single-platform to confirm multi-arch list is culprit. 2) If confirmed, revert bake change or force `--platform`. 3) If not, try building with old builder (previous build image tag) to bisect buildx change.
Jules: Rerun #1 started: buildkite.com/.../4524 (with `--platform linux/amd64`). I'll update in ~5m.
Anika: If rerun passes, we need a quick patch to bake to pin platform until registry fix. If rerun fails, we escalate to registry infra for deep-dive.
Jules: Rerun done — build 4524: PUSH succeeded. Looks like single-platform works. So multi-arch manifest list is the issue.
Priya: Thanks — registry team responded: there's a validation rule rejecting manifest lists without certain annotated fields for internal repos. They propose a short-term rule tweak but recommend we pin single-arch for now.
Ben: Ok, plan: revert the bake platforms change in PR #2381 and cut a quick follow-up to explicitly set `--platform linux/amd64` in our pipeline until registry policy is relaxed.
Anika: I'll open a PR to pin the platform and add a comment linking to this thread. @Jules can you add the buildkite rerun link to the PR? :thumbsup:
Jules: Will do. Posting links and closing for now — ping me if registry infra flips the policy or if anyone notices other repos affected.
ci-bot: buildkite: Build #4524 — PASSED — https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra/builds/4524
Ben: Thanks everyone — good catch on the bake change. Leaving bisect notes in the infra runbook.
Priya: registry-team: please keep us posted when rule change is live so we can revert the pin.
Anika: logging follow-up in the PR. Good triage team :shipit:
